title: Michael Renzi named Community Office Manager in First United Sabraton Office
summary: First United Bank & Trust is proud to announce Michael Renzi as the Community Office Manager for the Sabraton Office in Morgantown.
body_markdown:
First United Bank & Trust is proud to announce Michael Renzi as the Community Office Manager for the Sabraton Office in Morgantown.


In his new role, Renzi will oversee the daily operations of the office, lead and develop team members, and continue delivering the exceptional customer service and financial guidance First United clients have come to expect. He will also strengthen community relationships and support the bank’s mission of enhancing the well-being of the customers, businesses, and neighborhoods it serves.


“Michael has consistently demonstrated outstanding leadership, dedication, and a genuine commitment to both our customers and our community,” said Carmen Pennington, Regional Retail Manager at First United Bank & Trust. “His strong work ethic, customer-focused approach, and passion for helping others succeed make him the ideal person to lead our Sabraton office. We are excited to see him continue to grow in this role.”


Renzi has built a reputation for providing personalized financial solutions and fostering meaningful relationships with customers. Throughout his career with First United, he has demonstrated a dedication to professional excellence while actively supporting local organizations and community initiatives. As Community Office Manager, Renzi will continue to focus on creating an exceptional banking experience, empowering his team, and helping customers achieve their financial goals.


Renzi is located at First United Bank & Trust’s Sabraton Office and can be reached at304-291-6690 ormrenzi@MyBank.com .


Member of FDIC. First United Corporation operates one full-service commercial bank, First United Bank & Trust. The Bank has a network of community offices in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, and Frederick counties in Maryland, as well as Mineral, Berkeley, and Monongalia counties in West Virginia. First United’s website can be located at MyBank.com. As of 6/30/2026, the corporation posted assets of $2.1 billion.
